data.one_liner: A text widget supporting line expansion, clickables, hashtags, mentions, and custom tags.
data.what_it_does: Provides an expandable text widget that initially shows a defined number of lines of a long text with 'show more/less' triggers. It supports clickable mentions, hashtags, hyperlinks, and custom text segments with separate styling and callback options.
use_when: You need to display long post descriptions or comments that can be expanded and collapsed.
You need to highlight and handle taps on @mentions, #hashtags, and links within text.
You require smooth animations when toggling between collapsed and expanded text states.
avoid_when: You only need standard plain text without expansion or rich inline tagging features.
You need a full-fledged rich text markdown editor rather than a display widget.
strengths: Supports customizable styling for mentions, hashtags, links, and custom tags.
Provides animation capabilities for expansion and collapse transitions.
Includes tap callbacks for interactive text segments.
weaknesses: Limited to text display and inline styling features.
No document editing or form input capabilities.

alternatives.name: auto_size_text
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick auto_size_text if you need text to automatically resize to fit its bounding box rather than expanding lines.
